questions.question: What should "Done" do to an agent?

options.label: Just clear it (Recommended)
options.description: Hides the agent from Needs you inside AgentBar only

options.label: Close the worker too
options.description: Also closes the agent's herdr tab through the dashboard's Close action, after a confirm

questions.question: After you press Done or Park, the agent later starts working again and finishes. What should happen?

options.label: Back to Needs you (Recommended)
options.description: Any new work resets it, so you never miss a fresh question

questions.question: Should the orange menu-bar count and macOS notification be built in this round too?

options.label: Yes, for Needs you (Recommended)
options.description: The menu-bar icon shows how many agents are in Needs you, and a notification fires when a new one enters

options.label: No, panel only for now
options.description: Only the Needs you / Parked sections and Done / Park buttons
